ideas.title: GOP turns to Congress after Minnesota Dems block subpoena for Omar's Feeding Our Future records
ideas.description: Investigate the GOP's efforts to obtain records from Feeding Our Future and potential implications for Ilhan Omar.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential ties between Feeding Our Future and government officials.
questions: What are the GOP's concerns about Feeding Our Future?
How might this impact Ilhan Omar's reputation?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal potential conflicts of interest or misuse of funds by government officials.
